brand_story: Noah built DachKlar Service because they are specific — not interchangeable. Clients (30–50) should feel trust and desire to stay. Only then do we name the craft: dachreinigung.
first_screen_job: Hero exists for 'DachKlar Service': Frischer Regen nach dem Sturm — nasse Ziegel, klarer Himmel — Nach dem Regen sieht das Dach wieder neu aus.
question: Who is the human — and what idea can you feel?
